text:
Jon (People Ops): @here :memo: Heads-up — annual SOC2 / ISO evidence collection + privacy training deadline. We need every product and infra team to upload required evidence by Fri 2026-04-10 23:59 PT. Links and checklist below. Ping security/legal with questions.

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR of what's needed: 1) SOC2 evidence (access logs, change control tickets, system config snapshots). 2) ISO artifacts (risk register export, ISMS policy snapshots, internal audit notes). 3) Proof of privacy training completion (LMS export or screenshot). 4) Signed annual attestation form (one per manager). Upload to the secure evidence folder: https://redwood.example.com/evidence  — use the "2026-SOC2-ISO" folder. :lock:

Jon (People Ops): Required naming convention (please follow exactly):

```
<team>-<artifact>-<YYYYMMDD>-<owner_initials>.<pdf|zip>
examples: payments-accesslogs-20260318-JD.zip, infra-changecontrol-20260320-KM.pdf
```

Samira (Security): If any artifact contains customer PII or sensitive keys, redact before upload or use the encrypted upload option and tag the file "sensitive". Do NOT post secrets in public channels. If you need secure transfer, DM me and I'll provide a temp S3 presigned link. :warning:

Priya (Legal): Quick reminder — if your team received any customer evidence requests in the past year, include the correspondence and our response. Some of those need a short legal attestation; flag them in the upload notes.

Kai (Engineering Manager): Is there any flexibility on the Fri cutoff? Our sprint wrap + holiday overlaps. We can try to push, but a hard cutoff helps the audit team.

Jon (People Ops): We can accept team-level exception requests but they must be approved by both your manager and security. Ask for extension at least 72 hours before the deadline with: reason + ETA + mitigation. Send requests to jon@redwood.com and cc samira@redwood.com.

Kai (Engineering Manager): Got it. I'll consolidate our artifacts into one zip and submit by Thu.

Ava (People Ops): One more note — managers must complete the annual attestation form here: https://redwood.example.com/attestations/2026. It's a short checklist and signature. We will collect signatures and include them in the audit packet. :pen:

Samira (Security): We'll be running automated evidence validation (file types, naming, and basic checks). If validation fails you'll get an email with the failure reason. Please fix ASAP to avoid audit gaps.

RedwoodBot: :bell: Reminder scheduled — Compliance evidence deadline in 72 hours (Fri 2026-04-10 23:59 PT).

Jon (People Ops): Thanks everyone. People leads: please confirm in-thread when your team is uploaded so we can track progress. We'll post a final audit readiness snapshot on Wed.

Kai (Engineering Manager): Uploaded our zip just now to the folder. Confirmed.

Ava (People Ops): Received — marking payments, infra, and search as "submitted". Keep 'em coming. :thumbsup:

Samira (Security): If any team hits a blocker (e.g., missing logs older than retention), escalate immediately. We have mitigation playbooks but need early visibility.

Priya (Legal): Thanks — LMK if you want a quick review of any attestation language before signing.

Jon (People Ops): Final note: privacy training link (required for all staff): https://lms.redwood.com/courses/privacy-2026 — please complete and attach proof to the evidence folder. Managers: verify completion for your direct reports.

Ava (People Ops): We'll send a reminder email tomorrow morning with links and a status tracker. Cheers! :sparkles:
